title: Volley Machine Record
description: A paired machine's retained health record, published to volley/_system/machines/<name> by the machine itself every heartbeat (its LWT republishes it with tunnel down), and by the supervisor when the heartbeat stops. See spec section 4.6.14.

name.description: The machine's name: its peer account's username, the topic's last level and its hosts.<name> entry in the supervisor config.

os.description: Operating system as the runtime reports it (e.g. linux, darwin).

tunnel.description: up: the machine reached the broker through its tunnel when it published. down: its connection ended (LWT) or its heartbeat stopped (the supervisor's).

reason.description: Why the tunnel is down; absent while it is up.

agents.description: Agent sessions running on the machine (its tmux sessions).

remote_port.description: The port on the machine's 127.0.0.1 that reaches the broker (its hosts.<name>.tunnel.remote_port).

last_seen.description: When the machine last published a heartbeat.
